column1: # Generated by the server-only catalogue audit. Do not edit by hand:
# the audit is what grants an approval, and a name added here without one
# is a template nobody checked being served to players who cannot see it break.
# The fingerprint binds an approval to the template it was granted for. An
# entry whose fingerprint is "*" was approved before this build could compute
# one -- the four templates watched end to end on a stock client, recorded in
# evidence is real; the binding is not, and the registration says so every time
# it reads one. The resolved-runtime sweep replaces them with measured
# fingerprints and adds whatever else the catalogue audit approves.
#generated four templates watched in game, pre-sweep
